H4826.name: Marsena
H4826.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4826.brief: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media.
H4826.short: Marsena was one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who advised King Ahasuerus.

H4851.name: Mash
H4851.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4851.brief: Son of Aram, grandson of Shem.
H4851.short: Mash (or Meshech), a son of Aram, was a grandson of Shem.

H4854.name: Massa
H4854.desc: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4854.brief: Son of Ishmael, grandson of Abraham.
H4854.short: Massa, a son of Ishmael, was a grandson of Abraham.

H4811.name: Meraiah
H4811.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4811.brief: A priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim.
H4811.short: Meraiah, a priest who served during the time of Joiakim the high priest.

H4812G.name: Meraioth
H4812G.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4812G.brief: A priest in the lineage of Eleazar.
H4812G.short: Meraioth, a priest in the lineage of Eleazar, mentioned in genealogies.

H4847.name: Merari
H4847.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4847.brief: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.
H4847.short: Merari, the third son of Levi, was the founder of the Merarite clan of Levites.

H4822H.name: Meremoth
H4822H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4822H.brief: An Israelite who married a foreign woman.
H4822H.short: Meremoth, an Israelite who married a foreign woman during the Babylonian exile.

H4822G.name: Meremoth
H4822G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4822G.brief: A priest who returned from the Babylonian exile.
H4822G.short: Meremoth, a priest who returned from the Babylonian exile and was involved in the rebuilding of Jerusalem.

H4825.name: Meres
H4825.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4825.brief: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media.
H4825.short: Meres, one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who advised King Ahasuerus.

H4898H.name: Meshezabel
H4898H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4898H.brief: A leader who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H4898H.short: Meshezabel, one of the leaders who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.

H4898I.name: Meshezabel
H4898I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4898I.brief: A representative of the people to the Persian king.
H4898I.short: Meshezabel, from the descendants of Judah, was the people's representative to the Persian king.

H4898G.name: Meshezabel
H4898G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4898G.brief: One who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.
H4898G.short: Meshezabel, son of Berechiah, helped repair the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

H4877.name: Meshobab
H4877.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4877.brief: A Simeonite leader during Hezekiah's reign.
H4877.short: Meshobab, a Simeonite leader during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H4813H.name: Miriam
H4813H.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4813H.brief: A descendant of Judah, mentioned in a genealogy.
H4813H.short: Miriam, a descendant of Judah, is mentioned in the genealogy of Ezrah.

H4813G.name: Miriam
H4813G.desc: Moses' sister living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4813G.brief: Moses' sister, a prophetess who led women in worship.
H4813G.short: Miriam, the sister of Moses and Aaron, was a prophetess who played a significant role in the Exodus and the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

H4821.name: Mirmah
H4821.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4821.brief: A Benjamite mentioned in a genealogy.
H4821.short: Mirmah, a Benjamite, is listed in the genealogy of Shaharaim.

H4872.name: Moses
H4872.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4872.brief: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt
H4872.short: Moses was a prophet whom God used to lead Israel out of slavery in Egypt and give them the law.

H4831.name: Mareal
H4831.brief: A place on the border of Zebulun
H4831.short: Mareal, a place mentioned in describing the border of the territory of Zebulun (<ref="Joshua 19:11">Joshua 19:11</ref>).

H4809G.name: Meribah
H4809G.brief: A place where the Israelites quarreled with Moses
H4809G.short: Meribah, a place where the Israelites quarreled with Moses and tested the Lord, and where water came from the rock (<ref="Exodus 17:7; Deu.33.8; Psalm 95:8">Exodus 17:7; Deu.33.8; Psalm 95:8</ref>).

H4809H.name: Meribah
H4809H.brief: A place where Moses disobeyed God
H4809H.short: Meribah-kadesh, a place where Moses disobeyed God by striking the rock to bring forth water (<ref="Numbers 20:13">Numbers 20:13, 24; 27:14; Deu.32.51; Psalm 81:7; 106:32; Ezk.47.19; 48:28</ref>).

H4824.name: Meronothites
H4824.brief: A term used to describe two individuals in the Bible
H4824.short: Meronothite, a term used to describe Jehdeiah, who was in charge of King David's donkeys (<ref="1Ch.27.30">1Ch.27.30</ref>), and Jadon, who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem (<ref="Nehemiah 3:7">Nehemiah 3:7</ref>).

H4852.name: Mesha
H4852.brief: A place marking the Joktanite territory
H4852.short: Mesha, a place mentioned as the limit of the territory settled by the descendants of Joktan (<ref="Genesis 10:30">Genesis 10:30</ref>).

H4869B.name: Misgab
H4869B.short: Misgab, meaning "fortress," was a stronghold in Moab that faced judgment according to Jeremiah's prophecy.

H4861.name: Mishal
H4861.short: Mishal (Mashal), a Levitical city in the territory of Asher (<ref="Joshua 19:26; 21:30; 1Ch.6.74">Joshua 19:26; 21:30; 1Ch.6.74</ref>).
